cases.scenario: Student has an existing support ticket closed while original problem persists.

answer.mentor_note: Closed ticket: KA-12345. Current grade update policy: Difference Between Dropping and Withdrawing from a Course (KA-03332). Verify if the student's situation meets the criteria for a reopened ticket.

cases.scenario: Student has an existing support ticket closed while original problem persists.

cases.scenario: Student asks about checking grades and official withdrawal deadline.

answer.student_text: I checked my grades and one course is at 70%. I also want to know the official withdrawal deadline for this semester.
answer.mentor_note: Difference Between Dropping and Withdrawing from a Course (KA-03332), https://pathway.byu.edu/kb/article/KA-03332, still need to verify the current semester's withdrawal deadline.

cases.scenario: Student asks about checking grades and official withdrawal deadline.

answer.student_text: Hi, I wanted to check if I can see my grades and also what's the deadline for withdrawing from the course?
answer.mentor_note: Verified: 'Checking Your Grades' (KA-01234) and 'Withdrawal and Dropping Courses' (KA-09876). Deadline for withdrawal is 2 weeks from today. Next step: check Canvas for grades and confirm withdrawal eligibility.

answer.student_text: I feel frustrated that you kept telling me the same thing about signing in. I already know how to do it.
answer.mentor_note: Repeated advice was given three times; verify the student's actual sign-in status and provide a direct answer or a helpful next step.

cases.scenario: Student complains mentor repeated identical sign-in advice three times.

answer.mentor_note: Repeated advice was given; student has already completed the action. Next step: ask one focused question to help the student advance towards their goal.
